title: RiskScore
description: Predicted risk for one road segment. Produced by M2, consumed by M3 (edge weights for routing) and M4 (map colouring, dashboard). 1.1.0 = 1.0.0 + segment_id as string (road_segments.id is a UUID) + optional fields segment_code, governorate, components, predicted_condition, maintenance_priority(_score), contract_version. Every 1.0.0 required field is unchanged.

segment_id.description: road_segments.id (UUID) or the OSM way id when scored outside the database

risk_score.description: P(at least one adverse outcome on the segment within horizon_days) = 1-(1-components.accident)(1-components.condition). components.condition is the probability that a severity>=4 defect is observed (1.0.0 definition).

risk_level.description: Bucketed score: low <0.25, medium <0.5, high <0.75, critical >=0.75 (thresholds versioned with the model)

accident.description: P(>=1 road accident on the segment within the horizon), trained model thinned by exposure

condition.description: P(severity>=4 defect within the horizon) from M1 RoadEvents and complaints

top_factors.description: Features pushing the score up/down most, for explainability in the dashboard
